key_insight: OrbitForge turns a single text-generated video into a full closed-orbit 3D Gaussian Splatting scene by using 3D reconstruction as an anchor and iteratively filling only missing viewpoints.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical text-to-3D pipeline that avoids prompt-specific fine-tuning and score-distillation, making scene synthesis more scalable for graphics and simulation workflows.
method: Generate an initial video from text using frozen video priors.
Reconstruct a preliminary 3D scene with Deformable Gaussian Splatting plus a robust MedianGS proxy.
Render a prescribed orbit, identify missing views, synthesize only those views, then reconstruct the completed orbit into the final 3D scene.
evidence_signal: On a frozen 300-prompt T3Bench-derived audit, the method achieved a 359.0-degree median span and improved unsupported-bin Q10 ImageReward from 8.07 to 16.36 versus MedianGS-only reconstruction.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality and completeness of generated video views, so failures in orbit coverage or temporal consistency can still limit reconstruction fidelity.
paper_title: OrbitForge: Text-to-3D Scene Generation via Reconstruction-Anchored Video Synthesis
